profile.name: Vasu Garg
profile.title: Full Stack Engineer
profile.tagline: I build fast, reliable, production-grade web apps from front to back.
profile.bio: Full Stack Engineer with 4+ years shipping production web applications end-to-end across fintech, compliance, and security. I own the full lifecycle, from data models and REST/WebSocket APIs to state architecture and accessible UI.
profile.bio2: I care about scalable architecture, clean SOLID code, and interfaces that make complex, data-dense systems feel simple. Off the clock I'm exploring anime ⛩️ or games 🎮 and building side projects.

highlights: Built a teacher community platform for a client, with a post feed, threaded comments, profiles, groups, and role-based content moderation.
Enabled teachers to monetize and discover learning content by shipping in-app purchases for paid courses and a searchable, filterable resource-sharing module.
Led frontend for real-time AI interfaces (multi-thread streaming chat, in-app editors, and data-dense dashboards) used by 500+ active users.
Migrated a legacy Angular monolith to React micro-frontends in a pnpm and Turborepo monorepo, with end-to-end type safety and faster, cached builds.
Helped drive 1,000+ new signups in one quarter by designing event-tracking schemas and integrating Mixpanel, Meta Pixel, and Google Analytics across products to guide activation flows.
Cut application load time by ~40% through code-splitting, lazy loading, and leaner state management.
Mentored 2 junior engineers on code review practices and component design.
Owned end-to-end delivery of a MERN admin platform, including REST APIs, MongoDB schemas, RBAC flows, and React UIs, working directly with product and compliance teams.
Reduced bundle size by 35% (from 500 KB to 350 KB) by refactoring duplicated code into reusable components, speeding up load times across products.
Hardened the Node.js, Express, and TypeScript API layer with JWT auth, request validation, and modular routing, following SOLID principles and proven design patterns.

projects.name: AI Trading Assistant (uAlgos)
projects.description: Delivered an AI-powered, chat-based strategy builder with natural-language strategy creation, WebSocket-streamed LLM responses, and a custom in-app IDE for editing AI-generated strategy artifacts.
highlights: Cut strategy design time by ~40% with multi-thread chat that streams responses rendered from Markdown to HTML.
Built a calendar-style backtest heatmap (max P/L, win/loss streaks) with a trade-level breakdown.
Set up backend CI/CD with automated test, build, and deploy jobs.

projects.name: eKYC Multi-Vendor Platform
projects.description: Built a runtime JSON-configurable KYC platform with RBAC across 4 roles, securing review and approval workflows for 10,000+ submissions across 6+ B2B white-label clients.
highlights: Built an RBAC dashboard for admins, agents, RMs, and affiliates covering 10,000+ KYC submissions.
Cut manual workload by up to 60% by integrating Digio and DigiLocker for Aadhaar/PAN checks, eSign, live selfie, and QR handoff.
Sped up verification by ~30% and improved user satisfaction with a responsive, cross-device UI.

projects.name: Cove Drive: Encrypted Cloud Storage
projects.description: Built a zero-knowledge cloud storage product with hybrid AES + RSA encryption. Files are encrypted end-to-end on the client, so the server never sees plaintext.
highlights: Designed a zero-knowledge model combining AES (symmetric) and RSA (asymmetric) encryption.
Added password-protected sharing and chunked, resumable multi-file uploads for unstable networks.
Built on a clean OOP and SOLID architecture that was recognised internally and led to my promotion to Senior.

projects.name: Sekai
projects.description: Shipped a solo anime catalogue and tracker for browsing trending and airing anime, searching, and managing a personal watchlist. It pulls live data from the AniList GraphQL API, persists it with Firestore and Firebase OAuth, and installs as a PWA.
highlights: Persisted watchlists and progress tracking in Firestore with Firebase Auth.
Cached client and server state with Redux Toolkit and TanStack Query.
Shipped as an installable, offline-friendly PWA for desktop and mobile.

projects.name: VasuGarg Labs
projects.description: Built a pnpm + Turborepo monorepo of 13+ independent React apps that share a common UI, auth, and utility layer through local workspace packages. Each app builds and deploys to its own Firebase Hosting site.
highlights: Built shared UI, utility, and auth packages, with JWT access and refresh tokens handled by Axios interceptors.
Includes Formlyst, a visual builder that renders multi-step forms at runtime from stored config, and Pokeverse, a virtualized Pokédex with turn-based battles.
Cached builds with Turborepo and deployed each app to its own Firebase site.

education.degree: Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science
